A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same CAD-Coder work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–F are readable and support a complete comparison, including matching content moved between pages.

before.justification: v1 reports original text-to-CAD experiments and ablations in Tables 1–3, alongside qualitative generation, editing and failure analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experimental results, including the quantitative comparisons, ablations and supplementary qualitative analyses.

M1.justification: Both versions use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with supervised fine-tuning, CoT cold-starting and GRPO using the same geometric and format rewards. The code-delimiter typography edit does not change the stated procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Text2CAD-derived generation data and evaluation coverage. The instruction-based CAD editing examples and challenging geometric scenarios in Appendices E–F already appear in v1.

E2.justification: The comparator sets shown in Table 1, Figure 3 and Figure S2 are unchanged. v3 removes DeepSeek-R1 and Gemini-2.5-flash from the baseline paragraph, but neither has reported comparison results in v1; this does not establish removal of an evaluated comparison.

E3.justification: The training subsets, official test-set synthesis, mean/median Chamfer Distance and invalidity metrics, training schedules, batch sizes and eight-candidate generation setting are retained. Moving the implementation paragraphs between pages introduces no protocol change.

E4.justification: Tables 2–3 and Figure 5 retain the same component and data-quality ablations. Appendix B still reports CD-only reward training failure after approximately 200 steps, and the supplementary reasoning, editing and failure analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests. The point estimates and distributions of per-example geometric errors retain the same reporting practices.

E6.justification: All entries in Tables 1–3 and the qualitative results are retained unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports CAD-Coder mean/median CD of 6.54/0.17 on the table's scaled CD measure and 1.45% invalidity in both versions.

T1.justification: The SFT objective, Chamfer Distance definition and GRPO objective in Equations 1–3 remain unchanged, as do the reward thresholds and mathematical explanations. No formal assumptions, theoretical results or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about CadQuery representation, the training framework, dataset construction and generation performance. The expanded Figure 3 caption does not introduce a new core claim.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning geometric accuracy, CoT, reinforcement learning and data quality are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same limitations involving spatial misalignment, operation confusion and sparse-sampling-related reward hacking; the new Figure 3 wording restates existing interpretations.

D1.justification: The hyperparameters, hardware, software, prompts and code examples remain the same. Appendix A retains the seven-hour SFT and 146-hour GRPO durations and CadQuery version 2.3.1; no code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Section 2, the bibliography and the positioning relative to command-sequence and CadQuery-based approaches are unchanged. Figure 3's added descriptions of comparator categories repeat distinctions already present in the experimental discussion.

P1.justification: Limited edits update an author email, adjust code-delimiter typography, remove two unsupported baseline names from the prose and expand Figure 3's caption. The main narrative, section order and appendix text otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 moves from page 6 to page 7 and receives an explanatory caption; Figure 4 moves from page 7 to page 8. Figure 2 and surrounding text/table placement also shift, while the displayed models, plots and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 improves reporting consistency by removing DeepSeek-R1 and Gemini-2.5-flash from the baseline paragraph, aligning it with the comparisons actually shown in Table 1. Figure 3's expanded caption also clarifies the comparison groups, although it introduces the small typo 'ull model'. These are limited clarity gains; the scientific content, evidence and limitations remain unchanged.
